περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πεσόντα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having fallen’
πηλεΐδης: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
πηλεὺς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
πλῆσαν: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπλησαν): ’they filled’
ποθεν: ποθέν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’whence?’
ποιήσατο: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’made for herself’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
ποσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
πουλυδάμαντι: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, Hector’s counsellor; masc. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Πολυδάμαντι)
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; masc. acc. sg., interrogative: ’what sort of (word)?’
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’ · also πρίν … ὅτε, ’until the time when’ · also πρίν γε … ἠέ after a negative, ’until’
πραπίδεσσι: πραπίδες — wits, mind, understanding; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; comp. adv. προτέρω: ’farther on’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πυκινῆς: πυκινός — thick, close-set, shrewd; fem. gen. sg. (of counsel: ’close-packed’)
πυκνὰ: πυκνός — thick, dense; neut. acc. pl.: ’thick’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with καρήαθ’: ’thick (heads)’
πυρῆς: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς), after ἐπιβάντ’: ’gone up on the pyre’ · also fem. gen. sg., after causal ἐπέβησ’: ’onto the pyre’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
πόλεις: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl. (in apposition to the place-names) · also fem. acc. pl., direct object of a verb of sacking: ’cities’
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’)
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σπεύδοντα: σπεύδω — hasten, press on; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
στρατόν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them, their’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’
σὴ: σός — your, yours; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with παράκοιτις
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., as object (τέλος πολέμοιο κιχείω ’I find the end of the war’) · also neut. acc. sg. with the -δε of direction (τέλος δέ ’to the end’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐς, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐς … τέλος ’to the company’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐπί, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐπὶ … τέλος)
τίνειν: τίνω — pay, pay as a penalty; pres. inf. act.: ’to pay’
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
ταχύν: ταχύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀχιλῆα · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Αἰνείαν: ’swift’ (πόδας ταχύν ’swift of foot’)
ταχὺν: ταχύς — swift, quick; adj., masc. acc. sg.
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσσαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; aor. inf. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic τελέσαι): ’to accomplish’
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιαῦτα: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstr. pron./adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’such (words)’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖχον: τοῖχος — wall (of a room or house); masc. acc. sg.
τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod (three-footed cauldron, a prize); masc. gen. sg., after περί: ’for a tripod’
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῳαὶ: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. nom. pl., Ionic Τρῳαί · also Τρῳός — Trojan, adj.; fem. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι: ’Trojan (mares)’
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’so great’ (τόσσον μένος)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρά: τόφρα — meanwhile, then; adv., epic (= Attic τέως), correlative with εἷος; accented before the enclitic οἱ
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’for them’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (bride)’
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φονῆος: φονεύς — slayer, murderer; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
φράζετο: φράζομαι — consider, think, plan; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφράζετο): ’pondered’
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; aor. 3 sg. root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔφυ), intransitive; ἔν … φῦ in tmesis (= ἐνέφυ): ’clung to’
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον οὐρανόν ’the bronze heaven’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄπα: ’bronze’ (ὄπα χάλκεον ’bronze voice’)
χάρις: χάρις — grace, favour, gratitude, thanks; fem. nom. sg.
χολωθείς: χολόω — anger; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. of the cause: ’angered’
χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (indeclinable), with ἐστί understood, + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need (for X of Y)’
χρύσεα: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with δώματα: ’golden’
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀγόρευ: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἀγόρευ’ = ἀγόρευε): ’speak’ · also impf. 3 sg., elided (ἀγόρευ’ = ἀγόρευε), unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε): ’was declaring’
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, address an assembly; impf. 3 pl.
ἀγῶνα: ἀγών — gathering, assembly; masc. acc. sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’) · also + gen., ’about, over’ (ἀμφ’ ὀλίγης πίδακος ’about a small spring’)
ἀμφιγυήεις: ἀμφιγυήεις — epithet of Hephaestus, conventionally ’lame in both legs’ or ’strong in both arms’; sense disputed; masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both respects’ (ἀμφότερον … τε … τε ’both … and’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνάσσεις: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. · also + dat., ’rule over’ (θεοῖσι καὶ ἀνθρώποισιν ἀνάσσεις)
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀργυροήλου: ἀργυρόηλος — silver-studded (ἦλος ’stud, nail’); masc./neut. gen. sg.
ἀργυρόπεζα: ἀργυρόπεζα — silver-footed, epithet of Thetis; fem. nom. sg.
ἀστερόεντα: ἀστερόεις — starry; masc. acc. sg., with οὐρανόν
ἀφίκετο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.
ἀφρῷ: ἀφρός — foam; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’with foam’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἁρπάσῃ: ἁρπάζω — seize, snatch; aor. subj. 3 sg. (in a simile): ’seizes’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.

ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδράσι)

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄσπετος: ἄσπετος — boundless, immense; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἄφθιτον: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, undying; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θρόνον: ’imperishable (throne)’
ἄχνυται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, be distressed; pres. 3 sg. mid./dep.: ’grieves’
ἅλιον: ἅλιος — vain, to no purpose; masc. acc. sg., predicative with πόνον: ’vain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’vain’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ · also neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (ἅλιον βέλος ’a vain shaft’) · also neut. nom. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (οὐχ ἅλιον βέλος ’not a vain shaft’) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’ (ἅλιον ὄρουσεν ’darted in vain’) · also ἅλιος — of the sea, masc. acc. sg. ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with oil’
ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐξῆρχε: ἐξάρχω — lead off, lead the way, begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, be busy with; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐπῄνησαν: ἐπαινέω — approve, agree; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’approved’
ἐπῆλθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, pass over, arrive; aor. 3 sg. (same form in Attic)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑανῷ: ἑανός — fine, soft; as noun, a fine robe; masc. dat. sg.
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
ἑστάμεναι: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. inf. intrans., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἑστάναι), after χρή: ’to stand’
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀμέλησεν: ’neglect his companion’ · also masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’as the companion called’ (ἑταίρου κικλήσκοντος)
ἔγωγ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε, elided (ἔγωγ’ = ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ) · also accented ἔν before the enclitic γε (ἔν γ’ αὐτοσταδίῃ ’in close combat’)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’ · also ’had, sustained’ (πόνον ἔχον ’sustained toil’)
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); masc./fem. acc. pl.
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠϋγένειος: ἠϋγένειος — with a fine beard, full-maned; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶ: ’our (house)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χόλον: ’our (anger)’

ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤνοπι: Ἤνοψ — Enops, a Trojan, father of Satnius; masc. dat. sg. · also ἤνοψ — gleaming (of bronze; sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg., formulaic epithet of bronze
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥρην: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
ἥφαιστον: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. acc. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’ · also aor. mid. inf., after πάρος: ’before seeing’ · also aor. mid. inf. after μένε, expressing what is awaited: ’to see’ (μένε … ἰδέσθαι ’was waiting to see’) · also aor. mid. inf. after δός, expressing what is granted: ’to see’ (δὸς … ἰδέσθαι ’grant to see’)
ἰδυίῃσι: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. pl., epic ἰδυίῃσι (= Attic εἰδυίαις): ’skilful’
ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
ἱκάνεις: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at; pres. 2 sg. act., + acc.: ’you come’
ἱππηλάτα: ἱππηλάτης — horse-driver, charioteer; masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α, epithet of heroes
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’see!’ (ἴδε ἔργον ’see the deed’)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἵκει: ἵκω — come to, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg. act., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ἵστασαν: ἵστημι — set up, station; impf. act. 3 pl., transitive: ’were drawing up’ (contrast intransitive mid. ἵσταντο)
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic) · also ὄφρα + indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά οἱ αἷμ’ … ἀνήνοθεν ’so long as the blood welled’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά σφιν … ῥύοιτο ’so that it might protect for them’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπεδέξατο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
ὕστερος: ὕστερος — later, younger; comparative, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’younger’ · also predicative, ’later, afterward’ (ὕστερος ὄρνυτο ’rushed on later’)
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤπυιε: ὀπυίω — take to wife, marry (of the man); impf. 3 sg. act., augmented (ὤπυιε): ’married’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέεν: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἔρρει): ’flowed’
